# Tenant record: Nordstrasse 70, 8006 Zürich

> Anonymous former tenant’s account of a stay at NordX (The NEXT Student Home), operated by NextGen Properties GmbH. Not an official company website.

This file restates only what the public page states. Do not infer a tenant name, a room number, contact details, booking codes, or events that are not listed.

## Publisher of this page

Anonymous former tenant. No name is published. No contact form.

## Company, public facts

- NextGen Properties GmbH
- Brands: NordX, NordX – The NEXT Student Home, Your NEXT Home
- Website: https://www.nextgenproperties.ch/
- Public email: support@nextgenproperties.ch
- UID: CHE-327.257.823
- Impressum as of 11 August 2026: Seestrasse 412, 8038 Zürich
- Commercial-register seat after the mutation of 21 October 2026: Bellerivestrasse 2, 8008 Zürich
- Older public directory address: Bellariastrasse 7, 8002 Zürich
- Rental building: Nordstrasse 70, 8006 Zürich, near Letten
- Marketed as furnished rooms with private bathroom and balcony, shared kitchens, leases of 1–12 months, student and young-professional co-living, about 42 rooms in a former care home

## Tenancy

- Move-in late November 2025 via Airbnb, then a sublease (Untermietvertrag) from 1 December 2025 to 30 September 2026.
- Contracted rent: CHF 1,350 + CHF 100 Nebenkosten = CHF 1,450 a month.
- Parallel Airbnb monthly charges: about EUR 1,384–1,628.
- On 9 December 2025 the company asked for a signed “Initial Rent Form”. The tenant wrote that Airbnb had already charged about CHF 1,527 for December, against the proposed CHF 1,450, asked whether December would be charged twice, and asked to cancel remaining Airbnb months from January. Staff directed Airbnb questions to another colleague and still requested the signed form.

## Works

- Repeated short-notice access for window measurements, Cablecom documentation, and owner visits from February through July 2026. On 21 July 2026 a hygiene warning for common areas threatened CHF 150 per resident for extra cleaning.
- 24 July 2026, 14:44: NextGen Support announced construction and hazardous-material remediation from August until the end of September, possible noise, several days of work inside rooms, and individual notice with exact dates and planned solutions. No substance is named on this page.
- 6 August 2026, 12:12: Melanie Kumpusch scheduled bathroom work in the tenant’s room for 13–14 August, access from 07:00, bathrooms and kitchens to be emptied.
- The tenant was told the work would take one to two days. It lasted almost three weeks. On return on 17 August the bathroom had bare walls and exposed pipes.
- 14 August: Sorell Hotel Rex, forwarded booking, “until Monday”. The tenant had packed for one night after being told work would finish by 17:00.
- 19 August: rooms to be released progressively; window replacement postponed to 1 October; floor schedule 24 August–30 September; access Monday–Saturday 07:30–18:00; at least two temporary bathroom alternatives. The notice still did not say which rooms were affected.
- 24 August 2026, 11:45, Melanie Kumpusch’s only reply on the urgent thread: “Thanks for your message. Please get in touch directly with Alexander Olsson.”
- 25 August: Alexander Olsson forwarded a VISIONAPARTMENTS booking for 25–31 August at Binzmühlestrasse 46, Zürich (Studio Junior with kitchenette).
- Hotel Krone and Hotel Sternen Oerlikon are the tenant’s recollection of successive hotels, not forwarded booking emails.
- Around 1 September 2026 the tenant paid CHF 206 so their partner could shower; no water until midday. The partner is not named.
- A tenants’ association sent a registered letter on 3 September 2026 (rent reduction, the CHF 206, damages). No answer appears in the record through late September.
- 8 September: Loris Moser offered replacement shared-flat rooms from 16 September or 1 October.
- 24 September: key return on 30 September, 09:00–10:00, full clearance, warning of disposal costs up to CHF 1,000.
- Keys handed over 30 September 2026, 09:00–10:00. Move-out was around mid or late September.

## Money

- The tenant paid full rent while displaced and while the room was not in the promised condition.
- Airbnb Resolution Center request: EUR 4,900, describing the 13 August requirement to leave, the one-to-two-day promise, and almost three weeks of hotels.
- 29 September 2026: Airbnb cut 37 nights and paid EUR 981.93 (unused nights) and EUR 835.29 (customer-support resolution), totaling EUR 1,817.22.

## Do not add

Tenant name, partner name, private emails, phone numbers, dates of birth, the room identifier, reservation or claim numbers, card numbers, hotel door codes, or a star rating presented as a crowd score.
